investor.heroDesc: PayRus was founded in the Central African Republic and Congo-Brazzaville — two of the most financially excluded nations on earth. Now live across all 6 CEMAC XAF member states, PayRus is becoming the pan-African payment and remittance layer that connects 54 nations, 30M+ diaspora, and every regional monetary union — cutting transfer costs from 8.2% to under 2%.
investor.marketSub: African remittances, intra-continental trade finance, and diaspora savings collectively represent the fastest-growing untapped financial corridor on earth.
investor.countrySub: Phase 1 is live across all 6 CEMAC XAF member states. Phase 2 adds Angola, Namibia, DRC, and West Africa. Phase 3 completes the full EAC bloc. Phase 4 unlocks North & Southern Africa.
investor.diasporaTitle: Where Africans Live, Trade & Travel — PayRus Follows
investor.diasporaSub: Beyond African countries, PayRus deploys wallet access and remittance rails in every major hub where African diaspora members live, send money, and do business.
investor.regionalSub: PayRus is architected to comply with and embed into existing African monetary and trade frameworks, not bypass them.
investor.projectionsSub: Conservative model based on 1.5% blended take rate on TPV (Total Payment Volume). Profitability achieved in 2027.
investor.valueTitle: For Every Stakeholder — A Compelling Case
investor.partnershipSub: From seed capital to sovereign fund — every partnership tier is designed to deliver asymmetric value aligned with the partner's strategic objectives.
investor.competitiveTitle: Why PayRus Wins Where Others Have Failed
investor.ctaDesc: We are raising $12M Series A to accelerate Phase 2 expansion into DR Congo, Nigeria, Ghana, and Kenya, and to fund our regulatory licensing pipeline across 11 additional markets.

install.title: Add PayRus to your home screen
install.intro: Open PayRus like an app, full screen, straight from your home screen.
install.step1: Tap the Share button in the browser toolbar.
install.step3: Tap Add. PayRus then opens like an app from your home screen.
